description: This is a PHP source file defining the Filter model class for the OpenCart admin catalog module. It includes methods for managing filter groups and filters, such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving filter and filter group data from the database, with associated descriptions.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A model class for handling filter groups and filters within the OpenCart admin catalog module, encompassing CRUD operations and retrieval of filter-related data with localization support.

methods.name: addFilterGroup
methods.description: Creates a new filter group record in the database and adds descriptions for each language.

methods.name: editFilterGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing filter group record and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteFilterGroup
methods.description: Deletes a filter group and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getFilterGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific filter group along with its description for the current language.

methods.name: getFilterGroups
methods.description: Retrieves multiple filter groups with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalFilterGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of filter groups, optionally filtered.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a filter group in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a filter group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions in a specific language for filter groups.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions of a filter group.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter group descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Creates a new filter, linking it to a filter group and creating localized descriptions.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Updates a filter's details and descriptions.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Deletes a filter and its descriptions and removes associations with categories and products.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a specific filter and its associated filter group name.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves multiple filters with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalFilters
methods.description: Returns the total number of filters, possibly filtered.

methods.name: getTotalFiltersByFilterGroupId
methods.description: Returns the total number of filters associated with a specific filter group.

methods.name: addFilterDescription
methods.description: Adds a localized description to a filter.

methods.name: deleteFilterDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions of a filter.

methods.name: deleteFilterDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes filter descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getFilterDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter descriptions in a specific language.
